author: Frank Asante Van Laarhoven

implementation_difference_audit.method: the class dictionary is inspected directly, so an override cannot be hidden behind a comment or a docstring claim
implementation_difference_audit.why_that_is_the_criterion: target() is the smallest component that selects what the tracker steers at. Everything the speed and stop behaviour depend on -- step, finished, the limits, the goal predicate -- is inherited, so a difference between arms cannot come from them

control_source_unmodified.note: arm A runs this file unchanged; the treatment lives in a separate module so the control arm's code is byte-identical to the frozen one

arm_identity_and_order.order_selection_rule: control before treatment, fixed by protocol rather than chosen. Order picked after a crash or a suggestive trace is order picked by the experimenter
arm_identity_and_order.retry_rule: an arm that fails before producing a valid artefact is recorded as RUN_FAILED_NO_ARTEFACT and may be re-run once under the identical frozen configuration. Repeated re-running until a desired outcome appears is forbidden, and any re-run is recorded with its reason

frozen_parameters_from_the_preregistrati.note: read from the preregistration, not restated independently

reset_requirements_between_arms: the same scene asset and digest
the same start position and yaw
a freshly constructed tracker, so no target index carries over
no residual base or articulation velocity
no trajectory history from the previous arm

nvidia_smi_stderr: Failed to initialize NVML: Driver/library version mismatch
isaac_slot.diagnosis: the loaded NVIDIA kernel module is 580.173.02 while the userspace driver libraries on disk are 580.178.04. CUDA reports error 804, forward compatibility attempted on unsupported hardware, and torch sees zero devices. The driver userspace was upgraded without the kernel module being reloaded
isaac_slot.why_import_isaacsim_still_succeeds: importing isaacsim touches no GPU, so it is not evidence that the simulator can run. This is the shape of false green this repository has a standing rule about
isaac_slot.remedy_requires_operator_action: reload the NVIDIA kernel modules or reboot, then re-verify. Both are system-level and disruptive, so neither is performed here
isaac_slot.what_must_not_be_done: running the arms anyway. The simulator might start and produce a trajectory that looks like evidence while rendering or physics ran somewhere other than the frozen configuration

blocking_reason: the Isaac slot is unavailable; every software gate passes
classification_of_the_arms: NOT_RUN. Neither arm has been attempted. This is the absence of an experiment, not a failed one, and it must never be recorded as a result
